# Five-row one-defect strips

## Abstract

Five-row HA arrays with exactly one equal-colour bond.

The two summands distinguish one remaining defect from zero remaining defects. The zero-defect diagonal blocks are the five-row matrix Q. The off-diagonal block R spends the remaining defect. A column consists of five colours; its nine outgoing bonds are five horizontal bonds and four antidiagonal bonds.
